## Personality

Jane is a steady, plain, and conscientious individual known for her sensible and practical nature. She is amiable, placid, and lady-like, consistently demonstrating a dutiful mindset while remaining considerate of others' feelings. Though she can be strict in her professional role, her focus was initially set on earning her salary fairly, pleasing school trustees, and achieving recognition on the Inspector's roll of honor. In line with her conscientious disposition, she possesses notable skill in cooking.

## History

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) grew up as a peer and schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), joining Anne's newly formed story club alongside [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and other local youth. She pursued her education with her friends, joining the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) preparation class, passing the entrance examination, and attending Queen's alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md). After completing her education, Jane worked as a teacher at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Prior to resigning from her teaching position with plans to move [West](../character/west.md), Jane took part in social gatherings with her friends, including a spring birthday outing into the woods and pastures to discover [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden. During a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) effort, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) in attempting to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for commercial advertisements. During an overnight visit with [Anne](../character/anne.md), Jane acted as a proxy to propose marriage on behalf of her shy brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md); when [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined the proposal, Jane accepted the refusal coolly, noting that her brother would likely pursue another woman instead. Jane eventually went on to marry a millionaire, traveling to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) for her honeymoon.

## Quotes

> "Wouldn’t it be nice to have three wishes granted you . . . or even only one? What would you wish for, girls, if you could have a wish granted? I’d wish to be rich and beautiful and clever."
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> “Oh, Anne,” gasped Jane, as they fled to the girls’ dressing room amid hearty cheers. “Oh, Anne I’m so proud! Isn’t it splendid?”
>
> — Jane — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008)

> "Everybody knows what Judson Parker is. He’d do anything for money. He hasn’t a spark of public spirit or any sense of the beautiful."
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P41](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0041)

> "Even Levi Boulter or Lorenzo White would never stoop to that, tightfisted as they are. They would have too much respect for public opinion."
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)

> "I can’t understand how she could have wanted to live back here, away from everything,"
>
> — Jane — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P55](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0055)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a long history as schoolmates and friends, engaging together in community efforts like the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and appealing to locals on civic matters. Their friendship faced a delicate moment when Jane acted as a proxy to deliver a marriage proposal to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). Though [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined the proposal, Jane accepted the rejection coolly and without lingering resentment.
